title: Enhanced HTTP Session Handling (Cosmin Stefan, 2013 GSoC) in the zaproxy history
description: The 2012 and 2013 session-handling commits in zaproxy next to the Hall of Fame entry and the HTTP Sessions code that is still in core.

chapters.title: August 2012: an initial version
chapters.text: The earliest commit titled "Initial version of http sessions handling." is dated 2012-08-03. It is by cosminstefanxp. A follow-up dated 2012-08-04 says it was made "On the dev_sessions branch."

chapters.title: 2013: users, roles and session management
chapters.text: The Hall of Fame lists Enhanced HTTP Session Handling (Cosmin Stefan) as a 2013 Summer GSoC project. Its wiki goals include "allow users to set up and manage users/roles" and "allow ZAP to understand users/roles and associate them to HTTP Sessions". Commits by cosminstefanxp in the HTTP sessions paths include "Rest of required changes for the extension handling Users, Roles etc." (2013-07-02), "Redefined some Session Management interfaces. Simple implementation for Cookie based session management." (2013-08-08) and "Refactored Users, Authentication and SessionManagement packages with better names." (2013-09-19).

chapters.title: Where it stands now
chapters.text: The HTTP Sessions extension is still in the zaproxy tree (zap/src/main/java/org/zaproxy/zap/extension/httpsessions/ExtensionHttpSessions.java). The latest commit touching its paths is dated 2026-09-11 and is titled "Support control-return to submit all dialogs". The core help has an HTTP Sessions tab page.
